summary: Unused workflow_dispatch input 'warning_days' (lines 9–13) is speculative generality—defined but never referenced in job steps; users will see it but cannot override WARNING_DAYS. Otherwise excellent: PowerShell script is modular, testable, with dependency-injected ReferenceDate for determinism; YAML has pinned actions, least-privilege permissions, sensible triggers, idempotent steps, strong error messages.
